title: 8,000km E40 Bush Trip & Extreme Himalayan Landings! | MSFS 2024 Marketplace
description:
Ready to tackle high-altitude Himalayan landings, fly scheduled airline routes across two continents, or embark on an epic 8,000 km European road-tracking bush trip in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024? This week's Marketplace update delivers six new commercial mission packs and scenic VFR expeditions from Perfect Flight and Koschi! Whether you want to manage over 100 dynamic flight deck events in the LATAM A320neo, push airliners into thin mountain air, or explore World Update 23 terrain across Poland and the Baltics, this drop has plenty of structured flying to add to your logbook.

In this activity breakdown, we group all six new marketplace arrivals by flight style, verify required third-party aircraft prerequisites, and share honest tips on what to buy now versus wait on:

✈️ SCHEDULED COMMERCIAL AIRLINE ROTATIONS
We kick things off with structured IFR airline schedules and multi-leg passenger operations:
• 12LEGS – LATAM Fall 2026 (by Perfect Flight): Step into the default iniBuilds Airbus A320neo V2 with an official LATAM Airlines livery across 12 scheduled revenue sectors spanning Chile, Argentina, Paraguay, Brazil, Peru, Ecuador, the Galápagos Islands, and Colombia. Includes SIDs/STARs, over 100 monitored flight deck events, authentic cabin/crew soundscapes, and multi-language briefings.
• 12LEGS – A220 AFR Fall 2026 (by Perfect Flight): Take on 12 dynamic Air France A220 rotations featuring custom audio briefings and over 100 in-flight events. (⚠️ Prerequisite: Requires owning either the Synaptic A220 + Synaptic Livery Pack or the VirtualCol A220 Series).

🏔️ HIGH-ALTITUDE & EXTREME TERRAIN CHALLENGES
Looking to test your energy management and density-altitude flying where the air runs thin?
• Advanced Challenges – Himalayas Landings (by Perfect Flight): 24 tiered landing scenarios (Tiers 1 through 5) across demanding Himalayan strips using the CubCrafter, Pilatus PC-6, Daher TBM 930, Cessna Citation CJ4, Airbus A320, and Boeing 737.

🧭 EUROPEAN OVERLAND & BALTIC BUSH EXPEDITIONS
Prefer low-and-slow VFR navigation across historic highways and World Update 23 landscapes?
• E 40 – The Longest European Road (by Koschi): Follow the legendary 8,000+ km E40 route in the Cessna 208 Grand Caravan from Belgium (Bruges, Ghent, Brussels, Liège) through Germany, Poland, Eastern Europe, and Central Asia toward China—complete with 3 custom bush strips and 2 cleared airfields.
• Bushtrip Poland Part 1 & Poland & Baltics Part 2 (by Koschi): Pre-planned multi-leg VFR tours showcasing the overhauled scenery from World Update 23: Poland and the Baltics. (💡 Tip: Since Parts 3 & 4 are already out for MSFS 2020, consider holding off for a future 4-part MSFS 2024 bundle!).

Which of these new activities are you loading onto the ramp first? Testing your landing skills in the Himalayas, running LATAM A320 sectors across South America, or tackling the 8,000 km E40 expedition? Let us know in the comments below!

If this marketplace breakdown helped you find your next MSFS 2024 adventure, don't forget to hit that like button, subscribe for weekly flight sim coverage, and blue skies on your next flight!
